title: Calgary 2025 aerial orthophoto — direct public web tiles
authentication: No API key or token needed in tested public request.

accessEvidence.summary: The City guide describes public viewing and web-map use of hosted image services without a viewing licence agreement. Distribution of orthophoto files requires a licence. The 2025 orthophoto is listed without the permission restriction attached to Pictometry and some older years.
accessEvidence.itemLicenceSummary: Item metadata retains all-rights-reserved copyright language and restricts reproduction without City consent and a licence. Treat the more specific public-viewing guidance as permission for direct service display, not an open-data grant.

recommendedUse: Direct browser tile display with City attribution. Do not bundle, redistribute, proxy-cache or offer imagery downloads under an assumed open-data licence.
coverageCaveat: Citywide mosaic, with source extent bounding box retained. Rectangle includes areas where edge coverage may be incomplete. Not live imagery; 3D building overlays would come from a separate dataset.
